title: Map of the local area
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 2: Decimals; negative numbers; converting units; volume
source: Seeded from mathematics/y5 lesson 92 (Map of the local area (printable or online))
intro: Lesson 92: Metres and kilometres. To understand how to convert between metres and kilometres and solve distance problems

blocks.text: Open an online map of the area around school or home with an adult. Find three places and estimate the distances between them using the map's scale bar.

questions.q: Convert: 4.5 km; 0.8 km; 2 km 40 m (to m). 6,300 m; 90 m (to km).
Huda walks 1.25 km to school and 850 m to the library. Total in km?
A route is 3 km. 1.75 km is done. How many 250 m stretches are left?
Big question: how far is a kilometre?
questions.a: 1,000 metres: about 12 minutes' walk, or 2.5 laps of a track.
